structured.answer: Open an account at Pesagot and buy the ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) fund (5139282). The page says that pair leaves the most, 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, and the account choice matters far more (up to 22,985 ₪) than the fund choice (up to 4,492 ₪).

stuck.where: Leumi row in the accounts list
stuck.why: Says 'לא בחשבון: מחיר אחר לצעירים... לסטודנטים'. I'm a student, so maybe Leumi would be cheaper for me, but the page doesn't count that price
Had to match the tick colours with the legend at the very bottom, under the axis
Lots of chips on every row and the same ones repeat, so I couldn't quickly see what's different between funds

used: Big number 86,492 ₪ with 'הכי הרבה נשאר בזוג הזה' and the pair name
The 'כמה כל בחירה משנה' lines: 'עד 22,985 ₪' for the account and 'עד 4,492 ₪' for the fund
Top rows of the account list (Pesagot, Leumi) and the fund list (Yalin, Altshuler −43, iShares −213)

Whether I can withdraw money any time if I need it for rent

findings.what: The same chips (קרן מחקה, צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, מס גם על שינויי המטבע) repeat on every fund row, so I reread them all to find what differs
Tick colours on the comparison lines are only explained in a legend far below, under the axis, so I had to look back and forth
A student discount is mentioned but left out of the numbers, which is exactly my situation
Jargon in the fee lines isn't explained (דמי משמרת, נאמן)
findings.where: Account cost breakdown and fund card

findings.what: The cost bars in the account rows use small colour squares that you have to match to the numbers next to them
